verdict.rationale: Ramp documents enforced spend limits at the card and fund level: per-vendor virtual-card limits, funds with lock and activate controls, spend programs described as recurring-budget templates, and limits:write and departments:write scopes on its MCP server. That points to program-style budgets with automatic limits. However, no evidence explicitly describes setting department-level budgets that roll up and enforce across a department. Missing for 10: explicit department budget setup and enforcement documentation, budget tracking or overspend-blocking behavior, independent hands-on corroboration.
